perspective:
Jose knows that Patricia has seemed more withdrawn than usual at work, since she is normally vibrant. He asked if she was okay; she said it was “nothing really,” just “personal stuff,” and thanked him. He offered to listen, and she said that meant a lot.

During a lunch break, he overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments. He mentioned he had been reading about financial planning and offered to discuss budgeting tips. Patricia said she was “overwhelmed with my bills lately” and would take him up on the offer.

After that, Jose worried he might have overstepped by bringing up finances. He told Patricia he only wanted to help, not pry. She said she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful. He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; she said it was good to know she had someone to turn to.

Jose then sensed Patricia appreciated his concern but preferred to handle her issues privately. He checked in casually and asked about her weekend; she said everything was good and she planned a quiet weekend at home. He offered again to help or chat if she needed it, and she said she’d keep that in mind.

He continued checking in with her at work. Patricia said she was busy but handling things, thanked him for checking in, and told him it was great to have his support. Jose responded that he was there anytime and that they’re all there to help each other.
